included: standardized deterministic batch fan-out across candidates
strict sequential L0 to L1 to L2 promotion per candidate
auditable level input semantics, purpose, limitations, required artifacts, local checks and pinned gate refs
versioned connector identity with implementation and input/output schema digests
installed V1 L0/L1 and V2 L2 connector fingerprints
exact V3 StrategyAgentResult single-candidate compatibility with PIT source lineage
local LevelEvidence gate that ignores external promotion summaries
excluded: durable large-scale scheduler, priority, cancellation and failure recovery (V4-005)
Monte Carlo, scenario replay, parameter sweep and strategy comparison (V4-003)

acceptance.proof: test_v3_single_candidate_preserves_digest_and_pit_lineage binds the exact StrategyAgentResult digest and converts its immutable sha256-prefixed PIT lineage without changing content. NO_TRADE and DEFER are rejected by the adapter.

acceptance.criterion: Every level input, semantics, purpose, limitation and promotion gate is auditable
acceptance.proof: standard_level_contracts freezes L0/L1/L2 semantics, purposes, limitations, required artifact names, required local checks and content-addressed promotion gate refs; ValidationTask binds the contract digest, plan, candidate, connector and predecessor evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Existing runnable V1/V2 funnel is extended through versioned connectors
acceptance.proof: installed_v1_v2_connectors fingerprints V1 validation_tools/walk_forward/V4 plan execution for L0/L1 and V2 strategy_replay for L2, together with versioned input/output schema digests.

acceptance.criterion: External summaries cannot bypass local contracts
acceptance.proof: BatchResearchScheduler accepts only LevelEvidence returned by its configured local verifier; external_summary is retained in the connector-output digest but never consulted by the gate. A claimed external PASS with failed local checks produces FAIL and schedules no successor.
All candidates fan out at L0; only locally passing evidence queues the exact next L1/L2 successor with predecessor evidence digest. Failed candidates stop independently.

verification.result: PASS: format, ruff, mypy (150 source files), secret scan, 2 schema, 1 unit, 9 property, 805 contract, health

deterministic_boundary.connector: Only exact connector/task/schema bindings and locally verified LevelEvidence can advance a candidate. Connector summaries, Agent proposals and external tools cannot qualify, promote, trade, or mutate risk rules.
